findings.detection: renderer hardcodes type 'counter' for every ledger family, including the gauge family STAGE_DURATION_FAMILY if it ever appears in ledger.families
findings.detail: In collectPipelineOutcomes the loop over `ledger.families` calls `registry.add(family, help, 'counter', numeric, ...)` unconditionally, so any family other than the three counters (e.g. a hand-edited or future gauge entry) is emitted with `# TYPE ... counter`, contradicting the declared gauge type for STAGE_DURATION_FAMILY.

findings.detection: unknown ledger families are rendered with a fabricated HELP string instead of being dropped
findings.detail: The `: \`Pipeline ledger family ${family}.\`` fallback branch emits arbitrary family names from the on-disk ledger into the scrape, so a corrupt/hand-edited ledger can inject unbounded series names, contradicting the module's own 'unknown keys dropped' contract in normalizeLedger.

findings.detection: recordCounter coerces a non-positive delta to 1 instead of ignoring it
findings.detail: `const increment = Number.isFinite(delta) && delta > 0 ? delta : 1;` turns delta 0 or negative into an increment of 1, and the test 'is monotonic' explicitly pins this behaviour (`recordCounter(..., 0, ledger)` yields 5), so a caller passing 0 to mean 'no change' silently inflates the counter.

findings.detection: read-modify-write of the ledger is not atomic across processes, so concurrent producers lose increments
findings.detail: mutateLedger does `readLedger(file)` then `writeLedgerAtomic(file, snapshot)` with no lock; the atomic rename only prevents torn reads, not lost updates, yet the doc comment claims 'monotonic: counters only ever increase' — two producers (daemon + CLI) writing concurrently will drop one another's deltas.

findings.detection: stage duration recorded for skipped stages as 0 overwrites the last real duration of that stage
findings.detail: `recordStageOutcome(skippedResult.name, 'skipped', skippedResult.duration)` passes duration 0, and recordStageOutcome sets `last: duration`, so the STAGE_DURATION_FAMILY gauge for that stage drops to 0 after a skip even though the stage previously ran.

findings.detection: decodeSeriesKey does not unescape the backslash-escaped '=' in label values
findings.detail: encodeSeriesKey escapes `=` as `\=` inside values, but decodeSeriesKey only treats `\` as an escape for the next char while scanning for `,`; the `entry.indexOf('=')` split then runs on the still-escaped string, so a value containing `=` (e.g. `a=b`) decodes with a stray backslash — the round-trip test only covers `,` and `=` in the same value by luck of ordering.

findings.detection: ledgerPath parameter is threaded through collectMetrics/renderMetrics but the /metrics route caller is not shown passing it
findings.detail: collectMetrics and renderMetrics gained an optional `ledgerPath` argument, but the diff does not update the `app.get('/metrics', …)` handler in specs/mcp.spec.dir/src/server.ts to pass it, so the route relies solely on the env var / cwd default and the new parameter is only exercised by tests.

review.summary: The ledger/renderer wiring is mostly sound, but the renderer hardcodes 'counter' for all ledger families and emits unknown families with fabricated HELP, and the ledger's read-modify-write is not concurrency-safe despite claiming monotonicity.
